defects.title: Landing page retains scholarship-first primary journey
defects.body: Premise: `Solicitar bolsa` precedes `Seja um benfeitor` in the navigation, remains the highlighted navigation CTA and hero CTA, and its content band and quick-access entry appear first. → Path: a visitor using any of these landing entry points is directed to `/solicitar-bolsa` as the primary journey. → Verdict: the released landing page contradicts the donor-first contract and its required DOM ordering.
defects.suggestion: Make benefactor enrollment the first navigation/quick-access item, use it for both prominent CTAs and hero primary CTA, and move the benefactor band before the scholarship band while retaining scholarship as a secondary route.
evidence: Premise: app/page.tsx:397-405 orders scholarship before donor and highlights scholarship in navigation. → Path: navigation visitor follows the highlighted action. → Verdict: donor is not primary there.
Premise: app/page.tsx:422-429 makes the hero's first/highlighted action scholarship. → Path: hero visitor follows the primary CTA. → Verdict: the hero contradicts donor-first behavior.

Premise: app/page.tsx:519-573 places scholarship before benefactor in DOM order. → Path: assistive technology and document-order consumers encounter scholarship first. → Verdict: required band ordering fails.
Premise: app/page.tsx:634-638 orders quick access scholarship before donor. → Path: quick-access visitor chooses the first public action. → Verdict: required quick-access ordering fails.

Premise: _prd.md Core Features 1 requires the inverse ordering and donor primary action. → Path: each listed landing surface is an implementation of that contract. → Verdict: the implementation conflicts with the canonical artifact.

defects.title: Secretariat application view omits notes and issued documents
defects.body: Premise: the new Secretariat client renders only the summary fields and never calls the observation or issued-document actions. → Path: a Secretariat user opening `/admin/solicitacoes` receives this client for every application and therefore has no control to add/read operational observations or consult/download final issued documents. → Verdict: the required Secretariat operational workflow cannot be completed despite the backend actions existing.
defects.suggestion: Add a restricted per-application detail surface that loads chronological observations, allows Secretariat-only creation with the required concise-operational guidance, and lists/downloads current eligible issued documents by ID.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/solicitacoes/page.tsx:16-20 routes Secretariat users exclusively to `SecretariatApplicationsClient`. → Path: Secretariat opens the application list. → Verdict: only that client can expose its required workflow.

Premise: app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:81-106 contains no observation history/form or issued-document list/download action. → Path: Secretariat views any rendered application. → Verdict: those required operations are unavailable.

Premise: observation-actions.ts:8-34 and admin-actions.ts:786-818 expose supporting actions that this client never uses. → Path: no other Secretariat application component invokes them. → Verdict: backend availability does not complete the workflow.

Premise: _prd.md Secretariat Operational Application View and Final Document Access require both capabilities. → Path: this client is the role-specific surface. → Verdict: the product contract is unmet.

defects.title: Issued-document version allocation is not serialized
defects.body: Premise: the transaction reads the latest issued-document version and inserts `latest + 1`, but never locks the application row or otherwise serializes issuances. → Path: two Administrator reissues for the same application and kind can both read version N, both write distinct PDF files, then race to insert version N+1; one insert fails on the unique index. → Verdict: concurrent issuance does not satisfy the required serialized allocation and leaves a user-visible failed issuance under a realistic concurrent reissue.
defects.suggestion: Lock the application row (or use an equivalent per-application serialization strategy) before reading the latest version and inserting metadata, with a regression test that exercises concurrent issuance.
evidence: Premise: lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:19-35 has only a latest-version read and insert, without lock or retry. → Path: concurrent issuances read the same latest version. → Verdict: both allocate the same next version.

Premise: lib/db/schema.ts:386-389 uniquely constrains `(application_id, kind, version)`. → Path: concurrent duplicate next-version inserts race. → Verdict: one issuance fails rather than being serialized.

Premise: _techspec.md Final Document Issuance step 6 requires allocation while the application row is locked. → Path: persistIssuedDocument implements that allocation. → Verdict: the required concurrency mechanism is absent.

defects.title: Required uploads can be faked with nonexistent pending paths
defects.body: Premise: `uploadedPath` accepts any nonempty `pending/` string that lacks `..`; submission later records the storage size as `0` when the path does not exist and still inserts the document rows. → Path: a direct Server Action caller can place the same invented `pending/x` value in every required array, pass the newly mandatory schema, and create an application whose required evidence was never uploaded. → Verdict: server validation does not prove successful required uploads or preserve the required actual-file metadata contract.
defects.suggestion: Validate the exact pending-path shape/category and verify each referenced object exists with a positive actual size before transaction persistence; return field errors for missing uploads.
evidence: Premise: lib/validations/application-schema.ts:20-25 enforces only the `pending/` prefix and absence of `..`. → Path: direct caller submits invented `pending/x` values. → Verdict: schema accepts nonexistent uploads.

Premise: app/form/_actions/form-actions.ts:224-232 converts a missing object to size `0` without rejection. → Path: accepted invented path reaches metadata construction. → Verdict: absent evidence is treated as a document.

Premise: app/form/_actions/form-actions.ts:203-206 inserts rows after the weak schema passes. → Path: transaction commits the zero-size rows. → Verdict: application submission succeeds without required files.

Premise: task_05.md requirements 4, 5, and 15 require successful upload-backed documents and actual metadata. → Path: schema and transaction implement that boundary. → Verdict: their validation is insufficient.

defects.title: Canonical public surfaces do not consistently use the approved shared seal
defects.body: Premise: the landing retains its independently drawn `seal-art` SVG and the legacy form layout retains another inline seal, while the new canonical scholarship page is outside that legacy layout and renders no `SealLogo`. → Path: visitors to the landing receive a different page-level seal implementation, and visitors to `/solicitar-bolsa` receive no shared seal/header at all. → Verdict: the required single approved web seal asset is not consistently consumed by landing and canonical public pages.
defects.suggestion: Replace the landing and form-layout inline seal implementations with `SealLogo`, and give the canonical scholarship route the shared public layout/header so it consumes the same component with deliberate decorative or informative semantics.
evidence: Premise: app/page.tsx:334-383 and 389-391 define and consume inline SVG art rather than `SealLogo`/`/seal-arca.svg`. → Path: landing renders its branding. → Verdict: it bypasses the approved shared asset.
Premise: app/form/layout.tsx:28-183 still owns an executable inline seal. → Path: legacy form route renders its layout. → Verdict: duplicate page-level web seal geometry remains.

Premise: app/solicitar-bolsa/page.tsx:7-9 renders only availability/content and is not nested in `app/form/layout.tsx`. → Path: canonical scholarship visitor loads the canonical route. → Verdict: that page supplies no shared seal/header.

Premise: _techspec.md Shared Web Logo and Logo Consolidation require all listed web surfaces to consume the shared asset and remove inline seals. → Path: landing and scholarship are listed surfaces. → Verdict: their implementations fail the contract.

defects.title: Secretariat donor UI discards required operational fields
defects.body: Premise: the operational projection includes duration, payment method/date, reminder channel, chapel/priory, and enrollment date, but the new Secretariat client only renders contact, frequency, amount, and optional observations. → Path: a Secretariat user cannot consult the rest of the donor enrollment details needed for the specified follow-up from the only role-aware benefactor page. → Verdict: the operational donor view is incomplete relative to its contract.
defects.suggestion: Render the remaining allowed operational fields in the restricted donor card while continuing to exclude CPF, address/CEP, receipts, and management controls.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/benfeitores/client.tsx:80-90 receives the full allowed operational donor shape. → Path: role-specific client gets an enrollment record. → Verdict: it has all fields needed to render the specified view.

Premise: app/admin/benfeitores/client.tsx:93-100 omits duration, payment method/date, reminder channel, priorado_capela, and created_at. → Path: Secretariat consults the rendered donor card. → Verdict: required operational details are unavailable.

Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:127-140 already returns those permitted fields. → Path: page passes this projection to the client. → Verdict: the gap is a concrete client rendering omission, not authorization.
Premise: _techspec.md Benefactors lists each of these fields for Secretariat. → Path: `SecretariatDonorsClient` is the corresponding view. → Verdict: the implementation is incomplete.

suppressions.note: The legacy page calls Next's `permanentRedirect` directly to the exact canonical destination, which is the intended 308 redirect surface.
The component preserves caller `size`/`className` and provides empty alt plus aria-hidden for decorative usage and a label for informative usage.
